Chapter 6164: Bloodsparrow’S Curse

Chapter 6164: Bloodsparrow’s Curse

The high-heaven transformation and its power couldn’t withstand Li Qiye’s will in the form of a punch.

“Boom!” The punch traveled through the ocean of lightning and shattered this azure form.

It pierced Transcendent’s chest, causing blood and flesh to splash out from his back. Time came to a halt as everyone stood frozen.

Once they regained their wits, they saw Li Qiye send the guy down to the ground like a meteor.

Transcendent was the second strongest emperor of the dynasty, nearly at the primal realm. Most importantly, he created a mighty technique to imitate the high heaven. Alas, he still lost to a single punch. All seemed to be insignificant compared to Li Qiye’s will.

“Go!” Allmountain and the others launched an assault against Li Qiye since they had no other choice.

Their dao fruits and anima tree appeared, blotting out the sky. The five apex emperors summoned their unique domains and mustered all of their power.

“Allmountain Trueflame!” Allmountain’s dao included burning mountains into molten lava to pour down on Li Qiye. The scorching liquid melted everything along the way. One drop could burn a kingdom into dust and reach the continent’s core.

He was the strongest among these apex emperors since he was at the origination stage.

“Bloodsparrow’s Curse!” Bloodsparrow roared and spread her wings, illuminating the sky with a red glow.

She burned her true blood and turned it into a frightening curse. The blood curse coiled around Li Qiye, intending to drill into his body and burn him down.

Emperors shuddered after seeing her move. Although Allmountain was stronger, this curse might have a greater offensive potential. Allmountain’s lava could deliver a swift death while this curse would make the target suffer a fate worse than death. The pain would be too much for even emperors to endure.

“Solar Proliferation.” Golden Flower revealed her true body - a massive solar flower with a golden radiance.

She was a sight to behold as she released a rain of golden seeds. Unfortunately, this rain was anything but romantic since the raindrops surged for Li Qiye. Once they reached him, they turned into giant suns and detonated.

“Witch Flame!” Witch King also transformed into a giant with stars circling his hair. He opened his mouth and released a special type of flame. It was different from true flame due to its viscous nature.

It adhered to Li Qiye and nothing could extinguish or drive it away. Only ashes granted the flame satisfaction. Moreover, the quantity seemed to be endless due to Witch King’s current size. Li Qiye became the center of a fiery storm with no way out.

Four flame techniques entrapped him - the highest offense Sin had to offer. The remnant heat waves blasted the region, permanently changing the landscape. Sparks made it far enough to kill experts and ancestors who thought they were safe.

“I’ve never seen flames like this before.” Spectators turned pale.

The four types were stacked together and their potency erupted. If this continued, all of Sin could be flattened. The dreadful storm showed no sign of easing, compressing and pushing inward for the eye of the storm - Li Qiye.

“Is this similar to the extinguishment sought by primal ancestors?” A horrified spectator murmured.
